title: Every byte has a place now
highlights: Dataflow shows downloads, uploads and internet usage by application, with browser tabs grouped together and system services included.
Overview keeps activity up front, with internet usage in its top summary row. Focus quality lives in Insights.
The existing collector command starts screen-time and network workers together. Network setup or capture errors leave screen-time recording running.
After 30 complete days, detailed screen-time and internet records become permanent daily app summaries. Streaks include archived days.
Signed AppImage updates check when the app opens. Install an available update inside HyprTrack, and find the version and update controls in Settings.
A new What’s New page keeps release notes in the app. Insights and Applications have their own sidebar icons.

title: A clearer workspace, a little time to focus
highlights: A calmer desktop workspace with cleaner charts, compact metrics and six palettes in light, dark or system mode.
A persistent Pomodoro timer with focus blocks, short and long breaks, and an optional completion chime.
VS Code aliases share one application label, including historical activity, without rewriting existing rows.

title: Overview reads the day properly
highlights: Top five applications on Overview and day-by-day application drill-down from the activity chart.
Existing usage history and the AppImage update path are preserved.
